# Hydra

`hydra` &middot; _password-attacks_

Tests whether a login service accepts weak credentials you supply.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- A target host in scope (SSH, FTP, HTTP basic/form are common).
- Small user and password lists. Large lists can lock accounts.
- Explicit authorisation: unauthorised login attempts are a crime in most places.

## How to use it

Provide the target, the service, and lists of usernames and passwords. Start with a handful of credentials to avoid lockouts and account disruption. Only ever against systems you are authorised to test.

## Examples

```console
$ hydra -L users.txt -P passwords.txt ssh://192.168.1.10
$ hydra -l admin -P passwords.txt 192.168.1.10 http-get /
```
